bindings.label: Representative independence

bindings.statement: theorem induced_on_source {A J B K : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] (source : Presentation A J) (target : Presentation B K) (edge : CompatibleEdge source target) (a : A) : transfer edge (source.phi a)=target.phi (edge.map a)

bindings.statement: theorem induced_additive {A J B K : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] (source : Presentation A J) (target : Presentation B K) (edge : CompatibleEdge source target) (x y : J) : transfer edge (x+y)=transfer edge x+transfer edge y
bindings.label: Derived additivity

bindings.statement: theorem induced_integer_linear {A J B K : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] (source : Presentation A J) (target : Presentation B K) (edge : CompatibleEdge source target) (z : Int) (x : J) : transfer edge (z • x)=z • transfer edge x
bindings.label: Integer / DLP linearity

bindings.statement: theorem induced_reverse_norms {A J B K : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] (source : Presentation A J) (target : Presentation B K) (forward : CompatibleEdge source target) (reverse : CompatibleEdge target source) (n : Int) (source_elliptic_dual : ∀ a, reverse.map (forward.map a)=n • a) (target_elliptic_dual : ∀ b, forward.map (reverse.map b)=n • b) : (∀ x, transfer reverse (transfer forward x)=n • x) ∧ (∀ y, transfer forward (transfer reverse y)=n • y)
bindings.label: Both derived reverse norms

bindings.statement: theorem induced_chain_collapse {A J B K C L : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] [IntModule C] [IntModule L] (source : Presentation A J) (middle : Presentation B K) (target : Presentation C L) (first : CompatibleEdge source middle) (second : CompatibleEdge middle target) (x : J) : transfer second (transfer first x)= target.phi (second.map (first.map (source.lift x)))
bindings.label: Two-edge chain collapse

bindings.statement: theorem recover_on_annihilator {A J B K : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] (source : Presentation A J) (target : Presentation B K) (forward : CompatibleEdge source target) (reverse : CompatibleEdge target source) (n order inverse quotient : Int) (source_elliptic_dual : ∀ a, reverse.map (forward.map a)=n • a) (target_elliptic_dual : ∀ b, forward.map (reverse.map b)=n • b) (bezout : inverse*n+quotient*order=1) (x : J) (annihilated : order • x=0) : inverse • transfer reverse (transfer forward x)=x
bindings.label: Per-input full recovery

bindings.statement: theorem injective_on_annihilator {A J B K : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] [IntModule B] [IntModule K] (source : Presentation A J) (target : Presentation B K) (forward : CompatibleEdge source target) (reverse : CompatibleEdge target source) (n order inverse quotient : Int) (source_elliptic_dual : ∀ a, reverse.map (forward.map a)=n • a) (target_elliptic_dual : ∀ b, forward.map (reverse.map b)=n • b) (bezout : inverse*n+quotient*order=1) (x y : J) (annihilated_x : order • x=0) (annihilated_y : order • y=0) (same : transfer forward x=transfer forward y) : x=y
bindings.label: Carrier injectivity
